name: Swati Rastogi
medium: Mixed media, mandalas, tribal art, murals, public art
bio: From the time I remember, Art has always been my passion, driving me to a formal education that included my Bachelors in Fine Arts and Masters in History of Arts from India.
I have developed a style which involves my study, culture, traditions, aesthetics, emotions and intellect. Influences from folk and tribal arts of India consistently reflect in my creations.
I paint mandalas- a motif of completeness and integrity. The design begins from a circle and then gradually emanates to bigger and fuller pattern, keeping everything to one central point.
I also paint a lot of tribal art narratives of life and nature. Lately been experimenting some abstract compositions, textures and revisiting my much older themes.
I have lived a very artful life on the East Coast prior to moving to the Bay Area. I paint many mediums, murals and public art I enjoy the most.
